name: Minna de Yarou! Sex Volunteer
original_name: みんなでやろう!セックスボランティア
source:
Tsubomi Private Academy.
They teach things a little different here.

Giving is godly, is the overriding theme.
Service in the name of the school.
Service in the name of all for which we are grateful.
Gratitude service. Sexual gratitude.
Sex is service. Gratitude is sex. Sex is sex.
Everything is sex. Sex all the time.

Today is volunteer day. Let's be giving.
